title: How a Godly Man's Work Changes What He Stops Chasing in a Wife
caption:
A godly man who's building something stops chasing and starts becoming someone worth choosing. The work quiets the want.

A single season isn't a holding pattern before your real life starts, it's where the work actually gets done. Chase God with your head down and the search for her quiets on its own. She's not looking for a man with time on his hands. She's looking for a man who's building something real and would still make room for her in it.

Readiness isn't a feeling. It's a resume of small faithfulness.

#faith #singleness #purpose #godlyman #christianmen
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
